description: ImposmSyncSpec describes one OSM database kept in sync by imposm.

host.description: Host name, IP or socket directory. Optional with secretRef.

passwordSecretRef.description: PasswordSecretRef points at a key holding the plain password.

key.description: The key of the secret to select from.  Must be a valid secret key.

PgpassSecretRef points at a key holding a libpq password file
(CloudNativePG's <cluster>-app secret has one under "pgpass").

key.description: The key of the secret to select from.  Must be a valid secret key.

port.description:
Port, also opened by the runner's NetworkPolicy: a port in secretRef

schemas.description: SchemasSpec names the imposm schemas and the operator's bookkeeping schema.

state.description: State is where the operator records imports and applied diffs.

secretRef.description:
SecretRef names a Secret in the sync's namespace with the connection:
keys host, port, dbname, user and sslmode (each optional; the keys of
CloudNativePG's <cluster>-app secret). Its values win over the fields
above. Read by the runner only; the password still comes from
passwordSecretRef or pgpassSecretRef (which may name the same Secret).

name.description:
Name of the referent.
This field is effectively required, but due to backwards compatibility is
allowed to be empty. Instances of this type with an empty value here are

deletionPolicy.description:
DeletionPolicy decides what happens to the cache volume when the sync is
deleted. The database is never touched.

deploy.description: DeploySpec controls promotion from the import to the production schema.

auto.description: Auto deploys a new import once it has caught up with the upstream.

keepBackup.description: KeepBackup keeps the previous production data in the backup schema.

syncDuringReimport.description:
SyncDuringReimport keeps production receiving diffs while a new import
is built (after a mapping, SRID, prefix, limitTo or schema change, or the
reimport action), so its lag does not grow until the deploy. Each import
keeps its own imposm cache meanwhile. auto: when the volume has room for
a second cache (about 1.2 times the current one); always: regardless;
never: production pauses until the new import is deployed.

diffChunkSize.description: DiffChunkSize is how many diffs are handed to one `imposm diff` call.

imposm.description: ImposmSpec are settings forwarded to imposm.

cacheCheckpointLimit.description:
CacheCheckpointLimit: imposm's cache and the database are not updated
atomically, so before each diff chunk the cache is checkpointed and an
interrupted chunk is rolled back. Reflink clones (XFS, btrfs, ZFS) are
always used when available; otherwise the cache is copied if it is
smaller than this limit. Without a checkpoint an interrupted chunk
triggers a re-import (production keeps serving). "0" disables copying.

expireTiles.description:
ExpireTilesSpec enables imposm expire-tile lists (one "z/x/y" per line)
for tile cache invalidation: imposm's standard files on a volume, and/or a
Redis stream in zaptiles' format.
Tiles of a diff chunk are released only after the chunk committed and are
delivered at least once to every configured sink. When the changed tiles
cannot be known (a replacement import is deployed, or a chunk's commit was
only proven afterwards) the single tile 0/0/0 is sent, which invalidates
everything. Without files or redis, files are kept in the data volume
under expiretiles/.

files.description: Files writes imposm's <YYYYMMDD>/<time>.tiles files to a shared volume.

volume.description: Volume holding the files; typically an RWX persistentVolumeClaim.

csi.description: CSI is an inline CSI volume (the driver must support ephemeral inline use).

driver.description:
driver is the name of the CSI driver that handles this volume.
Consult with your admin for the correct name as registered in the cluster.

fsType.description:
fsType to mount. Ex. "ext4", "xfs", "ntfs".
If not provided, the empty value is passed to the associated CSI driver
which will determine the default filesystem to apply.

nodePublishSecretRef.description:
nodePublishSecretRef is a reference to the secret object containing
sensitive information to pass to the CSI driver to complete the CSI
NodePublishVolume and NodeUnpublishVolume calls.
This field is optional, and  may be empty if no secret is required. If the
secret object contains more than one secret, all secret references are passed.

name.description:
Name of the referent.
This field is effectively required, but due to backwards compatibility is
allowed to be empty. Instances of this type with an empty value here are
almost certainly wrong.
More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

readOnly.description:
readOnly specifies a read-only configuration for the volume.
Defaults to false (read/write).

volumeAttributes.description:
volumeAttributes stores driver-specific properties that are passed to the CSI
driver. Consult your driver's documentation for supported values.

nfs.description:
Represents an NFS mount that lasts the lifetime of a pod.
NFS volumes do not support ownership management or SELinux relabeling.

path.description:
path that is exported by the NFS server.
More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/storage/volumes#nfs

readOnly.description:
readOnly here will force the NFS export to be mounted with read-only permissions.
Defaults to false.
More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/storage/volumes#nfs

server.description:
server is the hostname or IP address of the NFS server.
More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/storage/volumes#nfs

persistentVolumeClaim.description:
PersistentVolumeClaimVolumeSource references the user's PVC in the same namespace.
This volume finds the bound PV and mounts that volume for the pod. A
PersistentVolumeClaimVolumeSource is, essentially, a wrapper around another
type of volume that is owned by someone else (the system).

claimName.description:
claimName is the name of a PersistentVolumeClaim in the same namespace as the pod using this volume.
More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/storage/persistent-volumes#persistentvolumeclaims

readOnly.description:
readOnly Will force the ReadOnly setting in VolumeMounts.
Default false.

field.description: Field of the message holding the tile lines.

maxLen.description: MaxLen trims the stream approximately; 0 disables trimming.

key.description: The key of the secret to select from.  Must be a valid secret key.

zoom.description:
Zoom is the deepest zoom of the expire tiles; imposm also writes
coarser zooms for large features. imposm only supports 6-18.

limitTo.description:
LimitTo restricts the import and all diffs to polygons (imposm limitto),
e.g. several regions from one larger extract and its replication.

cacheBufferDegrees.description:
CacheBufferDegrees keeps nodes this far (in degrees) outside the
polygons in the cache, so ways crossing the edge stay complete
(imposm limitto_cache_buffer). Decimal string, e.g. "0.05".

configMapRef.description: ConfigMapKeyRef selects one key of a ConfigMap in the same namespace.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: exactly one of inline or configMapRef

tablePrefix.description:
TablePrefix replaces imposm's standard "osm_" table prefix: tables are
named <prefix>_<table>. Only needed to run several syncs into the same
schemas (prefer separate schemas). Unset: imposm's osm_ tables.

mapping.description:
MappingSpec lists the parts of the imposm mapping. Parts are merged
strictly: a table defined in two parts is an error.

items.description: MappingSource is exactly one of ConfigMapRef or Inline.

configMapRef.description: ConfigMapRef: every selected key is one mapping part.

keys.description: Keys to use; all *.yaml/*.yml/*.json keys when empty.

inline.description: Inline mapping YAML, for small mappings and tests.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: exactly one of configMapRef or inline

maxDiffsPerRun.description:
MaxDiffsPerRun caps how many replication diffs one run applies, so a long
outage is caught up over several bounded runs.

metadata.description:
Metadata keeps OSM element metadata (version, timestamp, changeset),
optionally their history and the changesets, in tables next to
imposm's. Versions and timestamps work with any source; changesets
need one whose snapshot and diffs carry changeset ids (the public
Geofabrik downloads do not). Changing it never re-imports imposm's
tables.

changesets.description:
ChangesetsSpec keeps the changesets (comment, tags, bounding box) that
touch the sync's area, from OpenStreetMap's changeset replication.

bbox.description:
BBox "minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat": changesets whose bounding box
intersects it are kept. Default: the bounding box in the snapshot's
header.

indexText.description: IndexText adds a full-text index on changeset comments.

maxFilesPerRun.description:
MaxFilesPerRun bounds the replication files one run fetches (one per
minute upstream); a backlog is caught up over several runs.

replicationURL.description:
ReplicationURL is the changeset replication directory (the one holding
state.yaml).

retention.description:
Retention deletes changesets closed longer ago than this ("<n>d" or
"<n>h") that no kept metadata or history row refers to. Unset: kept.

elements.description:
Elements whose metadata is kept: none, tagged (every way and relation,
and nodes with tags), or all (also untagged nodes, about ten times the
rows).

history.description: HistorySpec keeps every version of an element seen since the sync started.

indexTags.description:
IndexTags adds a GIN index on the tags of the history (mode full), for
searching every edit of a tag.

mode.description:
Mode: none; versions (metadata of every version); full (also each
version's tags, node position, way nodes and relation members: an
audit trail of what changed).

retention.description:
HistoryRetention: when history rows are deleted or reduced. Durations are
"<n>d" or "<n>h". Unset: kept forever. An element's newest version is
never deleted while the element exists.

content.description:
Content (mode full) clears the content columns of versions replaced
longer ago than this; their metadata rows stay.

deleted.description:
Deleted removes the whole history of elements deleted in OSM longer
ago than this.

maxAge.description: MaxAge deletes versions replaced longer ago than this.

maxVersions.description: MaxVersions keeps only the newest N versions per element (0: all).

schema.description:
Schema of the metadata tables, one per sync (the first sync to use
it claims it; another is refused). Must differ from database.schemas.
Default: the production schema with "_history" (osm_history for osm).

runner.description:
RunnerSpec configures the sync Job pods.

The runner image and service account are set by the operator's admin (chart
values / controller flags), not per sync: whoever may write a sync must not
be able to run arbitrary code or borrow a service account through it.

activeDeadline.description:
ActiveDeadline bounds a single run, as a Go duration: "24h", "90m",
"1h30m", "38s". At least one minute. Import steps resume across runs,
but each step (e.g. imposm -write of the planet) must fit in one run.

annotations.description:
Annotations added to the runner pods (e.g. backup or autoscaler opt-outs).
Keys under imposm.johanjk.github.io/ are reserved.

imagePullPolicy.description: PullPolicy describes a policy for if/when to pull a container image

resources.description: ResourceRequirements describes the compute resource requirements.

claims.description:
Claims lists the names of resources, defined in spec.resourceClaims,
that are used by this container.

This field depends on the
DynamicResourceAllocation feature gate.

This field is immutable. It can only be set for containers.

items.description: ResourceClaim references one entry in PodSpec.ResourceClaims.

name.description:
Name must match the name of one entry in pod.spec.resourceClaims of
the Pod where this field is used. It makes that resource available
inside a container.

request.description:
Request is the name chosen for a request in the referenced claim.
If empty, everything from the claim is made available, otherwise
only the result of this request.

limits.description:
Limits describes the maximum amount of compute resources allowed.
More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/

requests.description:
Requests describes the minimum amount of compute resources required.
If Requests is omitted for a container, it defaults to Limits if that is explicitly specified,
otherwise to an implementation-defined value. Requests cannot exceed Limits.
More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/

items.description:
The pod this Toleration is attached to tolerates any taint that matches
the triple <key,value,effect> using the matching operator <operator>.

effect.description:
Effect indicates the taint effect to match. Empty means match all taint effects.
When specified, allowed values are NoSchedule, PreferNoSchedule and NoExecute.

key.description:
Key is the taint key that the toleration applies to. Empty means match all taint keys.
If the key is empty, operator must be Exists; this combination means to match all values and all keys.

operator.description:
Operator represents a key's relationship to the value.
Valid operators are Exists, Equal, Lt, and Gt. Defaults to Equal.
Exists is equivalent to wildcard for value, so that a pod can
tolerate all taints of a particular category.
Lt and Gt perform numeric comparisons (requires feature gate TaintTolerationComparisonOperators).

tolerationSeconds.description:
TolerationSeconds represents the period of time the toleration (which must be
of effect NoExecute, otherwise this field is ignored) tolerates the taint. By default,
it is not set, which means tolerate the taint forever (do not evict). Zero and
negative values will be treated as 0 (evict immediately) by the system.

value.description:
Value is the taint value the toleration matches to.
If the operator is Exists, the value should be empty, otherwise just a regular string.

schedule.description: Schedule is the cron schedule of sync runs.

baseURL.description: BaseURL of the mirror, e.g. https://download.geofabrik.de/europe/

checksum.description: Checksum verification of the snapshot against <pbf>.md5.

pbfPath.description: PBFPath is the snapshot path relative to BaseURL.

replicationBaseURL.description:
ReplicationBaseURL, when set, is the server for the replication files
instead of BaseURL: e.g. the snapshot from a planet mirror and the diffs
from planet.openstreetmap.org. Changing where diffs come from re-imports
(a different server may be a different sequence space).

replicationPath.description:
ReplicationPath is the replication directory (the one holding state.txt)
relative to ReplicationBaseURL (default BaseURL). "{frequency}" is
replaced by UpdateFrequency.

storage.description:
StorageSpec is the persistent volume for the imposm cache and downloads.
By default a PVC is created (size, storageClassName). Alternatively use a
pre-created PVC (existingClaim) or any other volume source (volume), e.g.
an inline CSI volume (nfs.csi.k8s.io, smb.csi.k8s.io, ...). The imposm
cache must survive between runs, so the volume must be persistent:
only persistentVolumeClaim, csi and nfs are accepted. size and
storageClassName are ignored with existingClaim or volume.

existingClaim.description: ExistingClaim uses a pre-created PVC instead of creating one.
